The Goonie Prowl

Fort Lauderdale, FL · Tarpon River

The Goonie Prowl is a social and cruiser group ride in Fort Lauderdale, FL. It meets every Friday, meet 7:30 pm, pedals 8:00 pm, starting at Tarpon River Brewing. Pace: D, 12–14 mph.

About the The Goonie Prowl group ride

Friday night social ride out of a brewery. Slow pace, stops for beer and food, any bike works. Bring lights.
